summary: Soma Fellows now describes a builder talent program connecting participants with companies, mentors and the Soma network. It links to applications but does not publish a fixed deadline or a standardized startup investment offer.

sources.title: Soma Fellows
sources.supports: Current company-placement/network focus, application link and current fellows.

notes: The former somafellows.com redirects here. Do not carry forward old startup accelerator funding promises.
The current offering is a talent-placement fellowship, not a confirmed standardized startup funding deal. An application link alone does not establish an active intake deadline.
